title: When the Kitchen Sings
author: Elodie Halloran
blurb: Marguerite Ravensworth, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
